Player targets create fresh abilityless shared-input clones with the authored 16-clone cap, current-normal launch and empty loadout; duplicated bodies retain the authored fan geometry, fresh-runtime/deferred-registration rules, ownership, scale, final shake and 1,800-pass lifetime without per-tick allocation. duplicator_broad_ab.sh runs 13 optimized-Q32 NativeAOT/Rust scenarios covering grounded/airborne form use, platforms, Grenade, Smoke, Tack, Mjolnir, Poke Ball capture, Mine, Missile, pickup-driven slot replacement, Gust, Time Stop and Dash. Target classes without a standalone public capture and rare cross-type duplicate expiry ordering remain documented in FULL_COMPATIBILITY.md.

abilities.name: Magnet gun
abilities.verification: MagnetGun's remaining source branches are now translated for every target class represented by the native world: ordinary and active-form players, active Rocks, all released ThrowItem2 bodies, Arrow, guided Missile, positive Black Holes, Macho boulders, ability pickups and PortalShots. A fixed tagged handle implements full nearest selection, authored scale/Rock/Boulder firepoint offsets, holder stealing, item/player/Black-Hole held-position variants, wall clamping and MoveObjectOutOfWalls, held-player ragdoll and rope endpoint pinning, signed Black-Hole pull, target-specific launch forces, timeout/distance/destruction loss and owner-death cleanup without per-tick allocation. magnet_broad_ab.sh runs 12 exact optimized-Q32 NativeAOT/Rust scenarios: 1,000 grounded/airborne form ticks, rounded-platform plus ordinary/Macho player pull, parry, released Grenade/Smoke/Poke Ball/Tack, layer-9 Arrow, guided Missile including the updater-sensitive airborne landing, 690 stopped passes and Gust on the active form. Newly translated Rock/player/Black-Hole/boulder/pickup/PortalShot holding and lock-loss/steal branches still lack exact public compositions, and generic weapon/spell bodies beyond PortalShot await their own native implementations, so status remains partial.

abilities.name: Rewind
abilities.verification: rewind_ability_ab matches 300 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks across recorded grounded and aerial movement, 150-tick history selection, 102-tick smootherstep/Catmull-Rom playback, input and physics suppression, platform raycast force, destination velocity/rotation/cooldown restoration, arrival depenetration and retained-ground release. dash_remaining_forms_ab adds 180 differential ticks through an overlapping Dash ray and the active form's nonlethal, no-push PlayerCollision callback.

abilities.name: Poke ball
abilities.verification: Poke Ball and its shared ThrowItem2/item path are source-ported wholesale: grounded and airborne form callbacks, held release, launch ownership/spin, circle contacts, strict fizzle, scaled nearest-opponent selection with lower-id ties and owner rejection, callback capture, pinning, ragdoll/invisibility/invulnerability, victim loss, pop/ejection, boundary/Portal/Black Hole/Gust/Magnet/Time Stop/Arrow paths, duplication, pickup-acquired use, and multi-captor shared-mask behavior. Item BoplBody mass now observes the prior pass scale before ScaleChanger, DPhysicsCircle radius retains its incremental fixed-point history, and proximity uses the source double-scaled radius. poke_ball_broad_ab.sh gates 4,668 Q32 NativeAOT/Rust ticks across eight programs; Growth and Shrink are exact through full item scaling, while the standalone scale-form pose retains a bounded 64-raw-unit reconstruction allowance. Duplicated callback capture is exact through two captors and 12 pinned passes; the later multi-captor expiry/ejection boundary remains source-ported but not individually differentially measured.

abilities.name: Gold mushroom
abilities.verification: Public rollout reproduces SuperStar's instant cast, next-pass effect initialization, four-second lifetime, airborne 0.85-strength jump override, 10,000-second live sentinel and five-second restored cooldown. gold_mushroom_ab matches NativeAOT exactly for 636 ticks.

abilities.name: Tack
abilities.verification: Tack and BananaPeel are source-ported wholesale through the shared grounded/aerial ThrowItem2 form, held and forced release, deferred Projectile ownership, live item scale/mass/radius phases, ballistic contacts, top-side settling, stable pin, strict arming/lifetime clocks, owner-clear immunity, source-order ordinary/abilityless-clone victim enumeration with transformed originals excluded, invulnerability, one-use kill attribution, death cleanup, duplication, Time Stop, Portal/Black Hole, Arrow, Gust, Magnet and pickup-acquired use. tack_broad_ab.sh gates 5,670 Q32 NativeAOT/Rust ticks over eight programs; Growth and Shrink are exact through full item scaling with the standard 64-raw-unit form reconstruction bound. Clone-victim, simultaneous-contact, Portal/Black Hole and acquired-pickup compositions are source-ported but not individually differentially measured.

abilities.name: Freeze ray
abilities.verification: freeze_ability_ab matches 1,000 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks across a grounded ordinary-player hit through immediate detach, 1.6-second FrozenSolid pin, cooldown reset, thaw impulse and ragdoll landing, plus an airborne diagonal cast through recoil and fire-animation exit. freeze_airborne_hit_ab adds 500 exact ticks for a rising ordinary-player hit through takeover, thaw, resumed fall and landing. freeze_water_self_ab adds 500 exact ticks for Water reflection through direct Ability.ExitAbility cancellation, retained aimed collider basis, self-freeze and thaw flight. freeze_bow_ab adds 500 exact ticks through active-Bow cancellation, restored-slime reattachment, pinning and grounded thaw. Gust, Time Stop and Dash form interactions are also exact. The complete source query is now ported: unmasked rounded-rectangle muzzle check, full mask/shape order, one-pass Water reflection, non-Player blockers, every active player form, alive/invulnerability gates and retained FrozenSolid pooling. Equipped Freeze collider identity is slot-indexed across initial loadouts, pickups, stock and revival clones. freeze_broad_ab adds 620 exact ticks through two equipped Freeze slots, active-Bow cancellation, a repeat hit while pinned, overlapping FrozenSolid clocks, first shatter/re-pin and final thaw. Remaining unmeasured classes and lifecycle boundaries are listed in ABILITY_PORT_GAPS.md.

abilities.name: Mjolnir
abilities.verification: Mjolnir and its ThrowItem2 payload are source-ported wholesale: grounded/airborne charge and forced release, scale propagation, Projectile owner/spin initialization, scaled overlap kills across ordinary slimes, abilityless clones and active forms in source search order, invulnerability/owner/alreadyKilled handling, outbound drag, stall and wall-clang return, live slime/clone/form recall targeting, speed clamp, owner death/body-swap coasting, catch/timeout, repeated platform force, Magnet/Portal/Black Hole shared-item interaction, duplication, Time Stop and side/water bounds removal. mjolnir_broad_ab.sh runs six optimized-Q32 NativeAOT/Rust scenarios covering airborne flight/recall, grounded clang and platform push, released Gust, both Time Stop phases, Duplicator fan copies and Dash against all ThrowItem forms; all pass. Current-form/clone victim and side-bound branches are source-ported but do not each have a standalone public differential.

abilities.name: Portal gun
abilities.verification: Executable instant cast, PortalShot rigid-body flight and wall/timeout landing, dominant-axis portal planes, pair replacement/linking, strict hysteresis, player and portalable rigid-body momentum mapping, and linked lifetime closure. portal_gun_ability_ab compares 1,290 NativeAOT/Rust Q32 ticks: the 900-tick primary scenario is exact, and a grenade crosses on the same tick with only the documented pre-existing ThrowItem2 launch-pose drift. dash_remaining_forms_ab adds 180 differential ticks through an overlapping Dash ray and the active form's nonlethal, no-push PlayerCollision callback. portal_arrow_ab adds 430 exact ticks through linked-mouth Bow Arrow traversal, mapped exit momentum and same-pass wall destruction. portal_pickup_ab adds 2,400 ticks through an AbilitySpawner pickup crossing an older linked pair, including hierarchy-ordered hover physics and exact post-exit motion; the maximum inherited launch-normalization difference is 101 raw Q32 units. time_stop_portal_ab verifies 690 frozen endpoint-clock passes and exact post-restoration player transit after nominal unfrozen expiry. portal_rock_ab adds 500 exact ticks through a PortalShot/active-Rock rigid-body impact, fresh recast collider ordering and later former-Rock transit. portal_gun_broad_ab.sh gates those five scenarios together after a whole-source audit. The source-wide BoplBody/SlimeController queries now also include abilityless Duplicator clones with shared player-id hysteresis, duplicated Rocks, and attached Spike/Engine/Tesla bodies; ropes and Black Holes are correctly excluded because their runtime objects do not carry portalable positive-mass BoplBody components.
